PostMN MassQL

Search the consensus MS/MS of a GNPS2 molecular-networking job for MassQL fragmentation patterns — product ions, neutral losses, precursor m/z. Give a GNPS2 Task ID (the clustered MGF + library matches are fetched for you) or drop the .mgf yourself. The MassQL runs entirely in your browser — a client-side port of the PostMN MassQL MetaboApp.

2 · MassQL queries

Pick predefined queries from the list (the same set as the original MetaboApp — bile acids, N-acyl lipids and the MassQL compendium) or write your own. Each named query tags the scans it matches; a scan can pass several. Type in the filter to search by name (e.g. dihydroxy, glycine) — matching single queries from every group are listed, so you can add just one. A predefined query can only be added once. To add many of your own at once, paste them or import a .tsv / .txt (or drop it on this box): two columns name⇥query, header optional, or one query per line. Export queries saves the current list in the same format.

Library Matches

    Same Rust MassQL engine as the MassQL Playground, compiled to WASM and inlined — a query that runs here runs identically in the CLI and at scale. In Task-ID mode the clustered consensus MGF (nf_output/clustering/spectra_reformatted.mgf for FBMN, specs_ms.mgf for classical) and the GNPS library matches (merged_results_with_gnps.tsv) are fetched over CORS from the GNPS2 server; the MassQL compute itself never leaves the browser. Predefined queries from the PostMN MetaboApp: MassQL compendium — Damiani et al. 2025; bile acids — Mohanty et al. 2024; N-acyl lipids — Mannochio-Russo et al. 2025.
